name: Mysterious Fossil
summary: Along Darkshore's coast, Prospector Remtravel uncovers the Mysterious Fossil. The Explorers' League sends it across the sea for study.

sections.title: A Curious Discovery
sections.body: Prospector Remtravel uncovers an unusual fossil while working along Darkshore's wild coast. He arranges for dwarven scholars to receive it instead of leaving it in the wilderness. In Darnassus, Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker sees an extraordinary find among the stones of Kalimdor.

sections.title: Ties Across the Ocean
sections.body: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker sees a likeness to a rare fossil once shown at an Explorers' League gathering in Ironforge. Archaeologist Flagongut studied that fossil and suspected it held power waiting to awaken. To confirm where the new fossil came from and learn what it may hold, Greywhisker sends it across the sea to Flagongut, who waits at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Where was the Mysterious Fossil found?
faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel found the Mysterious Fossil while working along Darkshore's ancient northern coast.

faq.q: Why does the Explorers' League want this fossil?
faq.answer: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker sees a link between the fossil and research by Archaeologist Flagongut. Flagongut suspects such fossils may hold power that can be awakened.

Archaeologist Flagongut researches for the Explorers' League and has studied similar petrified relics. He is staying at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor while awaiting an escort to the Whelgar Excavation Site in the Wetlands.
Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker is the Explorers' League's senior representative in Darnassus. Greywhisker oversees dwarven research and archaeological work across northern Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see the fossil as another missing piece in the Explorers' League's search for ancient titan heritage and forgotten mysteries.
As an Alliance member, you can trace the relic's route from field scouts in Darkshore to scholars in Darnassus and Menethil Harbor.
